title: Height-Balanced Invariant Preservation and Empirical Latency of a Chronos-Topology Skip List Aether-Index
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present a Chronos-Topology implementation of a probabilistic height-balanced search structure, the Skip List Aether-Index, designed for concurrent key-value storage. The design preserves a strict height-balanced invariant while supporting $O(log n)$ expected search, insert, and delete operations. We formally prove that the expected height of the list is bounded by $\log_{1/p} n$ and that the key-ordered invariant holds after each mutation. Empirical evaluation on an AMD EPYC 9V74 80-core processor (1 physical core, 2 logical threads) yields a mean latency of 2496.98 \textmu{}s (Std Dev $\pm$ 51.92 \textmu{}s) and a throughput of 400 484 ops/s over 30 benchmark iterations. The source code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Chronos-Topology-concurrency-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261118_110234_skip_list_chronos-index}.
